fact: Government Notice No. 57 of 28 January 2025 amends the Online Content Regulations to add 'unethical, fabricated and artificial intelligence generated content including video clips, audio and still pictures' to prohibited content, and obliges internet service providers and social media platform owners to filter and remove it.
title: The Electronic and Postal Communications (Online Content) (Amendment) Regulations, 2025
publisher: Ministry of Communication and Information Technology (GN No. 57)
